label: Human Past
scope_note: The human past and how it is known: prehistory, history by period, by region and by theme, archaeology and the methods of history.

label: Prehistory
scope_note: The human past before written records. Writing arose at different times in different places, so where prehistory ends differs by region.

label: Palaeolithic
scope_note: From the earliest known stone tools, about 3.3 million years ago, to the end of the last glacial period, about 12,000 years ago.

label: Neolithic and the beginnings of farming
scope_note: The shift to farming and settled village life, which began independently in several regions and at different times from about 12,000 years ago.

label: Early human dispersals
scope_note: The spread of humans out of Africa and across every continent except Antarctica, including the peopling of Sahul and the Americas.

label: World history by period
scope_note: The whole world's history divided into dated spans (Common Era years). Named periods such as 'Middle Ages' or 'Edo period' are regional labels and belong to regions, not to this axis.

label: Before 3000 BCE
scope_note: The world before about 3000 BCE, including the first cities and the first writing in Mesopotamia and Egypt toward its end.

label: 3rd millennium BCE
scope_note: The world from 3000 to 2001 BCE.

label: 2nd millennium BCE
scope_note: The world from 2000 to 1001 BCE.

label: 1st millennium BCE
scope_note: The world from 1000 to 1 BCE.

label: 1st millennium CE
scope_note: The world from 1 to 1000 CE.

label: 11th to 15th centuries
scope_note: The world from 1001 to 1500 CE.

label: 16th to 18th centuries
scope_note: The world from 1501 to 1800 CE.

label: 19th century
scope_note: The world from 1801 to 1900 CE.

label: 20th century
scope_note: The world from 1901 to 2000 CE.

label: 21st century
scope_note: The world from 2001 CE to the present.

label: History by region
scope_note: History of each world region, following the UN M49 regional divisions, plus the oceans that connect them.

label: History of Africa
scope_note: The history of the African continent and its peoples.

label: History of Northern Africa
scope_note: History of the region from the Nile valley to the Maghreb.

label: History of Western Africa
scope_note: History of the region from the Sahel to the Gulf of Guinea.

label: History of Eastern Africa
scope_note: History of the region from the Horn of Africa to the Swahili coast and the Indian Ocean islands.

label: History of Central Africa
scope_note: History of the Congo basin and neighbouring lands (M49: Middle Africa).

label: History of Southern Africa
scope_note: History of the southern end of the African continent.

label: History of the Americas
scope_note: The history of North, Central and South America and the Caribbean.

label: History of Northern America
scope_note: History of the northern part of the Americas (M49: Northern America).

label: History of Central America
scope_note: History of the isthmus from Mexico to Panama (M49: Central America).

label: History of the Caribbean
scope_note: History of the Caribbean islands and their peoples.

label: History of South America
scope_note: History of the South American continent.

label: History of Asia
scope_note: The history of the Asian continent and its peoples.

label: History of Central Asia
scope_note: History of the steppe and oasis lands of Central Asia.

label: History of Eastern Asia
scope_note: History of the region including China, Japan, Korea and Mongolia.

label: History of South-eastern Asia
scope_note: History of mainland and maritime Southeast Asia.

label: History of Southern Asia
scope_note: History of the Indian subcontinent, Iran and neighbouring lands (M49: Southern Asia).

label: History of Western Asia
scope_note: History of the region from Anatolia and the Caucasus to Arabia and Mesopotamia.

label: History of Europe
scope_note: The history of the European continent and its peoples.

label: History of Eastern Europe
scope_note: History of the eastern part of Europe (M49: Eastern Europe).

label: History of Northern Europe
scope_note: History of the northern part of Europe (M49: Northern Europe).

label: History of Southern Europe
scope_note: History of the southern part of Europe (M49: Southern Europe).

label: History of Western Europe
scope_note: History of the western part of Europe (M49: Western Europe).

label: History of Oceania
scope_note: The history of Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific Islands.

label: History of Australia and New Zealand
scope_note: History of Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand, including the tens of thousands of years of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander history and the history of Māori.

label: History of Melanesia
scope_note: History of New Guinea and the islands of Melanesia.

label: History of Micronesia
scope_note: History of the islands of Micronesia.

label: History of Polynesia
scope_note: History of the islands of Polynesia.

label: History of Antarctica
scope_note: The history of Antarctica: its sighting, exploration, science and governance.

label: Maritime and oceanic history
scope_note: The history of the seas and oceans and of the people who crossed, fished and traded on them.

label: History by theme
scope_note: History of particular aspects of human life across regions and periods.

label: Economic history
scope_note: The history of economies, work, money and trade.

label: Social history
scope_note: The history of everyday life, families, communities and social groups.

label: Political history
scope_note: The history of states, governments and political movements.

label: Military history
scope_note: The history of war and armed forces.

label: Environmental history
scope_note: The history of the relationship between people and the rest of nature.

label: History of science and technology
scope_note: How knowledge of nature and the tools of making developed in every civilization.

label: Intellectual history
scope_note: The history of ideas and of the people who held them.

label: Women's and gender history
scope_note: The history of women and of gender relations.

label: History of religions
scope_note: How religious traditions arose, spread and changed.

label: Global and connected history
scope_note: History across boundaries: exchanges, networks and processes that linked regions.

label: Trade networks
scope_note: Long-distance networks of exchange, such as the Silk Roads, the Indian Ocean routes, the trans-Saharan routes and the Atlantic system.

label: Empires
scope_note: Empires across the world and across time — among them the Achaemenid, Roman, Han, Maurya, Abbasid, Mali, Mongol, Ottoman, Inca, Mughal, Qing and British empires — compared as a form of rule.

label: Colonialism and decolonization
scope_note: Colonial rule and settlement, resistance to it, and the independence of colonized peoples.

label: Slavery and forced labour
scope_note: Slavery and other forms of unfree labour across history, including the ancient, trans-Saharan, Indian Ocean and transatlantic slave trades.

label: Revolutions and independence movements
scope_note: Revolutions and movements for independence and self-rule.

label: Archaeology
scope_note: The study of the human past through material remains.

label: Archaeological methods
scope_note: Survey, excavation and scientific dating and analysis of remains.

label: Cultural heritage
scope_note: Sites, objects and practices valued as heritage, their protection, and debates over ownership and return.

label: Historiography and historical method
scope_note: How history is researched and written, and the history of that writing.

label: Historical method
scope_note: Finding, criticizing and interpreting sources.

label: Oral history
scope_note: History gathered from spoken memories and testimony.

label: Chronology and dating
scope_note: Ordering events in time and reconciling calendars and eras.

label: Collective memory and commemoration
scope_note: How communities remember and commemorate the past, and conflicts over memory.

label: Biography and life writing
scope_note: Accounts of individual lives.

label: Genealogy and family history
scope_note: Tracing descent and family history.

label: Auxiliary sciences of history
scope_note: Specialized disciplines that date, read and authenticate historical sources.

label: Numismatics
scope_note: The study of coins, currency and medals.

label: Epigraphy
scope_note: The study of inscriptions.

label: Palaeography
scope_note: The study of historical handwriting and manuscripts.

label: Heraldry and vexillology
scope_note: Coats of arms, seals, flags and other emblems.
